paper_title: What are they talking about Benchmarking Large Language Models for   Knowledge-Grounded Discussion Summarization
caption: Overall performance gap 0.90\% of LLMs between the two KGDS patterns. A larger gap indicates lower stability in cross-pattern performance.

model_annotations.English: This bar chart illustrates the performance gap, expressed as a percentage, across several unnamed categories. The horizontal axis displays the categories, labeled with numerical values ranging from approximately 9.60 to 28.29, arranged in ascending order. The vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gap (%)” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, with tick marks at intervals of 5. There are seven bars, each a different shade of grey-blue. The first bar, corresponding to approximately 9.60 on the horizontal axis, is a dark grey-blue and has a height of 15.15. The tallest bar, corresponding to approximately 28.29 on the horizontal axis, is a medium grey-blue and reaches a height of 25.66. The remaining bars have heights of 23.79, 21.88, 18.80, 17.27, and 22.41, corresponding to values on the horizontal axis, and are represented in a similar color palette. No bars are visually emphasized, and the exact values above each bar are given to two decimal places.
